variants.headline: Still in view: party names a new leader
variants.sub: Leadership of a political party has changed in the colony.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A party has a new leader in {colony}.

This paper approaches {target} without a verdict supplied by the fact of replacement. Leadership has changed; the merits of conduct and proposals require their own assessment on an adequate record.

variants.headline: Still in view: leadership changes hands
variants.sub: A new leader is now at the head of a party in {colony}.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. Leadership of a political party has changed in the colony.

This paper approaches {target} without a verdict supplied by the fact of replacement. Leadership has changed; the merits of conduct and proposals require their own assessment on an adequate record.

variants.headline: Still in view: a new name at the head of the party
variants.sub: A party has a new leader in {colony}.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. A new leader is now at the head of a party in {colony}.

This paper approaches {target} without a verdict supplied by the fact of replacement. Leadership has changed; the merits of conduct and proposals require their own assessment on an adequate record.
